conventions.note: Mexico has no single national building code; these values are the Mexico City (capital-city) rule only. Built area (superficie construida, outside of walls) is the usual quoted dwelling area; the norm's minimum room areas are net. Net share is our own estimate.

research.note: Fire compartment limits and imposed loads live in other norms (fire protection, structural criteria) that were not read. The host copies are association/portal mirrors of the gazette text; the official gazette domain was not reachable from here.

note: Numbers with verified=true were read in the cited clause; the rest are hints with a note of where we looked. Wording is our own; no text of a standard is stored.
